mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (title, writer, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{writer}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT boardno AS boardNo,title,writer,writedate AS writeDate,modifydate AS modifyDate,readcount AS readCount,deleted FROM board WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY boardno DESC
SELECT boardno AS boardNo, title, writer, content, writedate AS writeDate, modifydate AS modifyDate, readcount AS readCount, deleted FROM board WHERE boardno = #{value} AND deleted = FALSE
